user.title: Source sensors
user.description: Select thermal power delivered to the floor circuit. Heat input is assumed zero outside the chosen heating mode. Unitless temperature sensors are interpreted as degrees C.

parameters.title: Thermal model settings
parameters.description: Fit both water-temperature models from a rolling training window. Scheduled learning defaults to every 7 days; only candidates passing later-cycle validation can replace the active coefficients. Manual parameter changes restore manual calibration. Disable automatic application for preview fits.

data.record_samples: Record local minute samples for fitting
data.import_history_on_start: Import Recorder history once before the first automatic fit

house.title: House digital twin (optional)
house.description: Two-state interior/envelope model from Bacher & Madsen (2011), Figure 1. Uses the room temperature selected on the first page. Solar must be irradiance in W/m² or kW/m². Check the source timestamp/averaging convention; hourly energy totals are unsupported. Manual defaults are starting guesses, not learned house properties. Existing floor operation is preserved when disabled. Combined occupancy and electrical heat gain enters the interior as a fitted constant, initially 500 W. The live twin corrects from the thermostat at local midnight; startup or recovery after missing inputs initializes from the room reading. Tomorrow demand reuses Open-Meteo forecast arrays and assumes steady state.

data.house_heat_input: Heat delivered to the house (exponent floor output)
data.house_import_history_on_start: Import house history before the first automatic fit
data.house_internal_gain: Manual occupancy and electrical heat gain (W)

error.house_unsupported_unit: Use W/kW for heat, °C/°F for outdoor temperature, and W/m² or kW/m² for solar irradiance.
